project_type: Full-stack educational AI platform: Python FastAPI backend, React frontend, Cloudflare Workers edge
build_system: pnpm workspace monorepo. Backend uses pip/requirements.txt. Edge uses wrangler/TypeScript.
test_framework: No test files found in the repo. Verification is via AST/syntax checks.
build_command: cd apps/backend && python -c 'import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in __import__("glob").glob("app/**/*.py", recursive=True)]'
test_command: cd apps/backend && python -m py_compile app/main.py && python -c 'import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in __import__("glob").glob("app/**/*.py", recursive=True)]'
verification_instructions: 1. Python syntax check all backend files. 2. TypeScript compile check edge worker. 3. JSX/JS syntax check frontend files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full package install available. No running MongoDB or Redis for integration tests.
contribution_requirements: Branch fix/hidden-functionality-audit already exists. All changes should maintain backward compatibility.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/api/v1/, models in app/models/, services in app/services/. Edge: Cloudflare Worker in apps/edge/src/index.ts. Frontend: React hooks in src/hooks/, context in src/context/, pages in src/pages/.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (FastAPI Python), apps/frontend (React Vite), apps/edge (Cloudflare Workers TypeScript)
